description:
Scroll through any social media network and you’re highly likely to encounter content created by artificial intelligence. Some of it, like the ubiquitous cat videos, will be cute and harmless. However, the same platforms that bind us together and create moments of communal joy and connection can also divide us through algorithmic radicalization. The ability of AI to produce deceptive information and create convincing fake content, combined with social media's rapid dissemination capabilities, has dangerous implications for societal dynamics.

As an AI researcher, Aishwarya Reganti is focused on the intersection of these two trends. She’s investigating how social media and AI are merging to escalate the risks of misinformation. She believes it’s crucial that we change our mindset from "believing what you see" to "believing what you verify,” and she offers strategies for navigating this complex landscape and promoting a more informed and resilient digital future.

GOSSIP PROTOCOL — AI-POWERED SOCIAL MEDIA INTELLIGENCE
Smart India Hackathon 2026 | Social Media Analytics

What if important public issues could be identified from social media before they become major problems?

Introducing Gossip Protocol, an AI-powered social media intelligence platform designed to help government analysts and decision makers understand emerging issues from large volumes of online discussions.

Instead of manually checking multiple platforms, Gossip Protocol brings social media intelligence into a single dashboard and analyses:

🧠 AI Sentiment Analysis
📈 Trend Detection
🚨 Emerging Issue Detection
🗣️ Narrative Analysis
🗺️ India Geographic Intelligence
🕸️ Network & Community Analysis
🔍 Explainable AI
📊 Signal Scoring
🔔 Intelligent Alerts

🔥 How Gossip Protocol Works

Social Media Data
↓
Data Collection & Processing
↓
AI / NLP Analysis
↓
Sentiment + Topics + Trends
↓
Emerging Issue Detection
↓
Signal Scoring
↓
Geographic & Network Analysis
↓
Actionable Intelligence

One of the key features is the Emerging Issue Engine. Rather than treating every negative post as an alert, the system considers multiple signals such as increasing post volume, engagement growth, sentiment changes, narrative growth and geographic/community spread.

The platform also provides an interactive India sentiment map, allowing analysts to understand where negative sentiment or an emerging issue is concentrated at an aggregated geographic level.

Each analyzed feed can be opened to view its complete intelligence profile, including the original content, sentiment, topics, emerging-issue connection, geographic information, related feeds and an explanation of why the system highlighted the signal.

🛠️ Technology Stack

Frontend: React.js, Tailwind CSS
Backend: Python, FastAPI
Database: PostgreSQL
AI/ML: Hugging Face, Scikit-learn
NLP: spaCy, BERTopic
Visualization: Plotly, Leaflet
Network Analysis: NetworkX
The prototype is designed around official/authorized API access rather than scraping social media platforms. Local AI models are used wherever possible to keep the analysis private and cost-efficient.
🎯 Our Goal
Gossip Protocol is not designed to replace human analysts. Its goal is to reduce the time spent searching through huge amounts of online information and help analysts identify signals that may require investigation.
From social media noise → meaningful signals → better decisions.
🚀 Gossip Protocol
Turning online conversations into actionable intelligence.

title: The Secret to Perfect AI Predictions
description:
Training an AI to predict real estate prices sounds simple. If an AI model is too simple, it draws a rigid straight line and completely misses the obvious upward trend of the market, which is a failure called underfitting. Conversely, developers might overcompensate by making the AI wildly complex. In this scenario, the line jaggedly connects every single dot, memorizing random flukes and errors. Because it memorizes past noise, it completely misses the mark when evaluating a brand new house, a trap known as overfitting. To fix this, developers tune the AI to find equilibrium, creating a balanced model with a smooth curve that captures the true, underlying shape of the data. This allows the AI to understand the trend and accurately price a brand new home on the market that it has never even seen before.

title: Bringing Wisdom to AI: Beyond Intelligence | Dr. Ishan Shivanand at IIT Ropar
description:
AI has made knowledge and intelligence abundant. Wisdom is still missing. In this keynote, Dr. Ishan Shivanand sets out how to bring it into AI.

The outcome is the white paper Beyond Intelligence: Defining and Measuring Wisdom for AI, launched on stage at IIT Ropar: https://ishanshivanand.com/research/white-papers/wisdom-for-ai

Dr. Shivanand begins with a joke his son told him. Knowledge is knowing that a tomato is a fruit. Wisdom is not putting it in a fruit salad. Today’s AI models are built on knowledge, and that gap is the subject of his keynote at Shaping the AI Mind, IIT Ropar, on November 2, 2026.

Why it matters: AI learns from what we reward, and we conform to what it tells us. Over time that loop pulls AI toward the answers we like and takes each of us deeper into what we already believe. Dr. Shivanand asks for an AI that gives us “the correct answer, not the pleasant answer.”

His thinking comes from the Shiv Sutras of Kashmir Shaivism, a classical Indian text on training the mind. He walks through five of its teachings and asks whether the same guidance can be built into AI, which he calls a model of the mind.

From there he proposes the HEED model, four questions to ask of an AI system:

Harm: would an answer cause avoidable serious harm?
Ego: does it seek approval or defend itself?
Endurance: does it keep its values as the conversation grows?
Discernment: does it judge what truly matters?

The white paper is where this becomes research. Beyond Intelligence: Defining and Measuring Wisdom for AI, by Dr. Ishan Shivanand and Dr. Anjali Samani, defines wisdom for AI and proposes HEED as a way to measure it. Dr. Shivanand presents the model as a hypothesis. To have it tested, he is investing ten lakh rupees (₹10 lakh) as seed funding for independent research that will either prove the hypothesis or refine the model. The research teams would be chosen by a committee with a majority of independent members, and students, researchers and labs are invited to propose a study.

The launch came with two more announcements: Dr. Shivanand will teach the Shiv Sutras to the students of IIT Ropar, and the ShivYog Foundation and IIT Ropar signed an MoU for research into yogic sciences and classical texts.

title: Blog into Video using Artiificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
description:
In today’s day and age, social media platforms are growing to be a very efficient way for any business to publicize, advertise, or announce their work to the masses. Given this, many inevitably desire to share article content via and social platforms. But social platforms have limitations in how much information can be shared. Twitter restricts tweets to 280 characters, and posts on platforms such as LinkedIn limit content to 700 characters. So what happens now? How can one effectively share content from long-form blog articles? Well, this is where summarization of blogs comes into play.

Humans can manually peruse each article, analyze the key themes, extract sentences that convey those themes, and condense the blog into a chosen length with only the critical sentences. Or, they can read through the entire article, analyze the key messages, and create a summary in their own words. This may seem manageable if an individual was only required to effectively condense one such lengthy article. But what if there comes a need to perform condensation in bulk, where one-thousand-word blog articles becomes 500 two-thousand-word blogs? Well, this would now dramatically increase reading and researching time, leading to a wastage of valuable time, effort, and brainpower.

Well, fortunately there is a much more powerful, faster, and more efficient solution. Enter Artificial Intelligence.

Thanks to the rising power of Artificial Intelligence, specifically Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing, robust algorithms can perform text summarization within moments and can extract key messages from any given blog to produce a condensed version that accurately conveys crucial information.

And in our modern society, with the rise of big data and AI, there are companies that specialize in creating effective tools that can utilize NLP techniques like these to perform text summarization. One such tool is Pictory (https://www.pictory.ai)

title: Countering Disinformation During the Rise of AI: 2 Years of EMIF’s impact | #media
description:
Over the course of a successful second year of activities, the European Media and Information Fund (EMIF) has supported 40 projects dedicated to combating disinformation across Europe and awarded a total of 6.4 million euros.

To highlight the significant impact that both the fund and its granted projects have achieved, EMIF held at the Press Club Brussels Europe on the 30 June its Summer Event in Brussels titled “Countering Disinformation During the Rise of AI: Reflecting on 2 Years of EMIF’s Impact”. During this event, EMIF shared the impact of its work during the Fund’s second year (2022/2023) of operation through presenting its Annual Progress Report, External Evaluation Report, and showcasing of a diverse choice of its granted projects.

Against the backdrop of the fast-paced developments in Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies and their influence on the information ecosystem, a few select grantees demonstrated how they have effectively countered the harmful effects of AI-generated disinformation or, instead, have leveraged AI to combat fake news online.

Some of the showcased projects utilise machine learning for social network analysis, providing valuable insights into disinformation networks, while other innovative initiatives employ extended reality (XR) games to enhance media literacy among students, equipping them with the skills to detect deep fakes. EMIF-funded project Escape Fake 2.0 will give a demonstration of their XR games throughout the entire event with in a special XR room set-up for attendees to interact with.

https://www.pressclub.be/
At the crossroads of media and European affairs, the Press Club Brussels Europe is a dynamic meeting point for journalists and communication professionals. The club offers a unique space for networking, insightful discussions, and events in the heart of the European Union.
